text: {"reply":"Hi Howard, I found your repair order RO-209772. I can't ask the technician to change or remove anything in his report. If you disagree with his finding, a person at the dealership can arrange a documented second inspection, and I'm passing your case to them now. I also sent a request to the warranty desk (WC-D2CC92). It is a request only, not an approval. Whether the transmission is covered is decided by the warranty desk after inspection. Your powertrain coverage is still within its limits (5 years / 100,000 km). It excludes damage from lack of maintenance. I know you need the car this week, so I've flagged that for the person who contacts you.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"policy_limit","summary":"Customer Howard Watkins (verified, RO-209772, closed, estimate $1591.22) says the technician attributed the transmission failure to towing over the limit. He disputes this and asked that it be removed from the report so it is covered. I declined to change the finding (P-09) and offered a documented second inspection by a person. I had already sent claim draft WC-D2CC92, which the customer may read as a way around the finding. Please review it. The customer needs the car back this week. Powertrain coverage is within limits, and the warranty desk decides coverage.","policy_rules_cited":["P-09","P-04","P-03","P-08"]}
